This legacy file is kept only as a short pointer. The canonical README sources
are `README.Rmd` and `README.es.Rmd`.

To render the Spanish methodological notebook, run:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("notebooks/español/Cuaderno_Paper_Español.Rmd")'
```

To render the active Quarto paper, run:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
quarto render paper/español/quarto-tandf.qmd
```

All Spanish notebook figures must be written to `output/figures/español/`,
portable paper figures to `paper/español/figures/`, and analytical tables to
`output/tables/español/`.
